artboards.title: 3 · Agency — changed after approval (back to YELLOW)
4 · Set Up Guide — the gantt, big colour bars, Go Live in the header

annotations.text: The rule (Kevin + Claude, 2026-08-31): a screen owns its indicator. RED = a required field is empty. YELLOW = everything saved, awaiting the lane owner's approval (Attest). GREEN = approved. Any saved change to approved data → YELLOW + a notification to the approver. The Set Up Guide (gantt) reads the screens and carries Go Live; Settings and Configuration is navigation only.
